scope: Reviewed additive application updates; immutable clean-baseline artifacts remain unchanged

functions.name: get_public_frontend_business_affiliations
functions.authority: Current public business and listed organisation; active affiliation, consented logo and only currently organisation-funded support.

functions.name: frontend_form_draft
functions.authority: Live authenticated account, only its own temporary form data; expected account protects against a session switch.

functions.name: purge_frontend_form_drafts
functions.authority: Service-only scheduled purge; bounded deletion of expired autosaves.

functions.name: expire_stale_checkouts
functions.authority: Service-only scheduled sweep run by the payment status job; bounded, repeatable expiry of pending payments with no Ozow request, created over an hour ago and not leased.

functions.name: record_payment_problem
functions.authority: Service-only record by the website's server of a refused payment notice or status-check transaction or a settlement outcome that needs staff; closed reason and source lists, an existing payment or none, one row per payment and reason, repeats only counted; an alert mark only rises, and after it was emailed another Ozow transaction raises it again at most 5 times; holds no personal data.

functions.name: claim_payment_alerts
functions.authority: Service-only five-minute lease, for the email job, on marked payment problems not yet emailed and raised in the last 7 days; a batch whose send failed is offered again unchanged first; bounded (1-50), returns payment numbers, reason codes and the payment amounts and states stored when the batch was prepared, never account or contact details.

functions.name: complete_payment_alerts
functions.authority: Service-only record that the staff email for one lease was sent, or its return for the next run; only rows of that lease not yet recorded.

functions.name: claim_payment_digest
functions.authority: Service-only five-minute lease, for the email job, on the day's staff payment summary once per South African calendar day from the given hour; the content is fixed at the first lease and stored, so a retry gets the same summary; returns counts, payment numbers and reason codes, never account or contact details.

functions.name: complete_payment_digest
functions.authority: Service-only record that the day's staff payment summary was sent (or logged); only the summary of that lease, once.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_payments
functions.authority: Current payment viewing capability and live authenticator session; minimal paged payment fields without provider identifiers or metadata.

functions.name: record_frontend_staff_payment_reversal
functions.authority: Current payment refund capability and recent authenticator proof; only another account's settled payment, local effects and exact audit receipt in one transaction.

functions.name: start_slot_checkout
functions.authority: Caller-bound slot quote: only an Individual slot plan on sale, 1-25 slots, the cooling-off consent recorded in the payment, an accepted ID review, the server total equal to the total shown and at most R10,000, and the person's Individual slot limit (every account of the same identity, slots in open payments included); one payment with one line per slot.

functions.name: get_my_slots
functions.authority: Caller-bound read of the member's own slots (active, or ended in the last 3 days) with the posts in them and the sponsor's name for a sponsored place, and the person's Individual slot count, open-payment slots and limit; no other account's data.

functions.name: record_staff_slot_reversal
functions.authority: Current payment refund capability and recent authenticator proof; only one slot line of another account's completed payment: revokes that slot, ends its posts and reverses only its commission, with the staff member, kind and reason on the line; the payment is reversed when its last slot is.

functions.name: staff_set_individual_slot_limit
functions.authority: Current slot limit capability (administrators) and recent authenticator proof; only another account with an accepted ID review; more than 4 (at most 25, until an end date within 366 days) only with a checked business; every raise and end kept with the staff member and reason.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_organisation_detail
functions.authority: Current organisation management capability and recent authenticator proof; scoped organisation detail with published business contacts and masked invite addresses.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_organisation_directory
functions.authority: Current organisation management capability and recent authenticator proof; newest 200 organisations with live administration totals.

functions.name: save_frontend_organisation_profile
functions.authority: Current organisation management capability and recent authenticator proof; atomic private creation or exact revision profile edit.

functions.name: get_frontend_affiliation_workspace
functions.authority: Live member session; only the caller's own business posts, applications, affiliations and organisation membership.

functions.name: execute_frontend_organisation_action
functions.authority: Verified organisation administrator or current authorised staff with recent MFA; exact organisation and funding bound to the native command.

functions.name: get_frontend_organisation_dashboard
functions.authority: Live organisation administrator membership and native organisation authority; only scoped totals, administrator roster and currently public business contacts.

functions.name: reserve_frontend_cipc_document
functions.authority: Current reviewed business owner; immutable case and document intent with bounded exact retry.

functions.name: reserve_frontend_cipc_official
functions.authority: Current independent reviewer and fresh TOTP; represented live evidence claim and separate official PDF intent.

functions.name: record_frontend_cipc_parse
functions.authority: Trusted parser only after signed caller and stored PDF integrity. Owner/staff provenance and claim are rechecked; no raw identity or other directors' fingerprints are retained in the presentation.

functions.name: get_frontend_cipc_preview_context
functions.authority: Trusted parser for current confirmed business owner; returns only an index into the supplied director list and a profile address hint.

functions.name: request_frontend_cipc_recheck
functions.authority: Current reviewed owner; one open request, actual 60-day renewal window or a current same-owner source registration.

functions.name: decide_frontend_cipc
functions.authority: Fresh independent staff decision and represented live claim. Current official In Business copy, exact registration, current director/representative proof, and other-owner conflict guard. Name exception needs separate senior review.

functions.name: revoke_frontend_cipc
functions.authority: Fresh senior reviewer for a represented approved case; revoked source badges invalidate linked publication.

functions.name: start_frontend_cipc_email
functions.authority: Trusted work-email sender after live owner proof; one challenge per case per minute and private 15-minute digest.

functions.name: mark_frontend_cipc_email_sent
functions.authority: Trusted sender marks only the represented current challenge after provider acceptance.

functions.name: verify_frontend_cipc_email
functions.authority: Trusted signed owner-code verifier; dispatched challenge, bound case, expiry and five persistent attempts.

functions.name: record_frontend_cipc_callback
functions.authority: Fresh independent staff reviewer and current claim; represented verified work email and callback record.

functions.name: switch_frontend_cipc_representative
functions.authority: Current owner may switch their represented open director check to the representative route without losing evidence or messages.

functions.name: set_frontend_cipc_office_visibility
functions.authority: Current owner controls whether a currently approved registration displays street and postal code.

functions.name: correct_frontend_cipc_office
functions.authority: Fresh independent staff reviewer and represented current evidence claim; validated private office correction.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_business_review_state
functions.authority: Current business owner only; current stickers, open and historical cases, representative progress and same-owner links, no fingerprints or code hashes.

functions.name: get_frontend_business_review_queue
functions.authority: Current queue staff; bounded canonical registration and Seen summaries with exact queue counts.

functions.name: get_frontend_cipc_case
functions.authority: Current queue staff; private documents, notes and callback facts require a live claim or prior reviewer relation and fresh TOTP; evidence access is recorded.

functions.name: get_public_frontend_business_cipc
functions.authority: Current eligible public business registrations only. Street and postal code are returned only with current owner consent.

functions.name: reserve_frontend_seen_reply_file
functions.authority: Current business owner; attachment is bound to the open Seen case and stays private until sent.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_business_checks
functions.authority: Current owner only; business case and current Seen sticker state, no staff findings or private evidence.

functions.name: request_frontend_business_seen
functions.authority: Current verified business owner; explicit consent and represented business, with an exact retry acknowledgement.

functions.name: withdraw_frontend_business_check
functions.authority: Current owner of the represented open check; closes the native evidence case and starts existing retention.

functions.name: get_frontend_seen_queue
functions.authority: Current queue staff; bounded visit queue summaries and counts with no visit address or photo content.

functions.name: get_frontend_seen_case
functions.authority: Current staff; sensitive details require fresh TOTP and a current claim or assigned reviewer relationship, with an evidence access log.

functions.name: reserve_frontend_seen_photo
functions.authority: Current assigned verifier only; reserves a bounded distinct native encrypted evidence upload.

functions.name: get_frontend_seen_photo_receipt
functions.authority: Current assigned verifier; only a matched clean stored photo receives a successful receipt.

functions.name: schedule_frontend_seen_check
functions.authority: Current assignee or independent live case claimant; represented current case and booking time.

functions.name: report_frontend_seen_check
functions.authority: Current assigned verifier; represented case, validated report and at least three distinct verified photographs for a successful visit.

functions.name: decide_frontend_seen_check
functions.authority: Fresh staff decision and live claim; approval requires independent staff, current identity and retained photos. Close or return the represented case atomically.

functions.name: revoke_frontend_seen_check
functions.authority: Current senior staff with fresh TOTP and represented approved check; removes its public sticker immediately.

functions.name: send_frontend_seen_message
functions.authority: Current owner or current authorized staff for the represented open Seen check; closed private text thread.

functions.name: authorize_frontend_seen_file
functions.authority: Fresh staff MFA and assigned, final reviewer or live claim relationship; no object key returned; access must be logged before download.

functions.name: frontend_seen_file_object
functions.authority: Trusted service only after signed reviewer authorization; checks the native clean artifact receipt and retention.

functions.name: get_public_frontend_business_seen
functions.authority: Bounded public eligible businesses; current approved Seen sticker, dates, method and canonical city only. No address or evidence.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_role_review
functions.authority: Fresh staff role reviewer; bounded roster, represented proposals and applied history.

functions.name: propose_frontend_staff_role
functions.authority: Fresh staff role reviewer. Canonical role snapshot, self-change prohibition, and owner invitation required for full administrator. Only permitted admin demotions take effect directly.

functions.name: review_frontend_staff_role
functions.authority: Fresh independently authorized reviewer, represented current proposal and prior assignment. Role and outcome commit together; new assignments require TOTP after the grant.

functions.name: get_frontend_partner_admin
functions.authority: Current partner administrator and fresh TOTP; bounded canonical partner, referral and commission data without customer contact or provider payloads.

functions.name: save_frontend_partner
functions.authority: Current partner administrator and fresh TOTP; delegates to native authority and commits any staff note in the same transaction.

functions.name: get_frontend_support_metrics
functions.authority: Current support staff; actual open support totals and oldest timestamp with no ticket body.

functions.name: submit_frontend_support
functions.authority: Trusted server after origin, CAPTCHA and rate checks. Exact short-window retries reuse the recorded support reference.

functions.name: record_frontend_support_mail
functions.authority: Trusted server records provider acceptance for one approved template without storing provider diagnostics.

functions.name: get_frontend_support_inbox
functions.authority: Current support staff, bounded paged request and mail activity projection with database-authorized edit hint.

functions.name: update_frontend_support_status
functions.authority: Current support moderator or admin, represented revision; status and audit event commit together.

functions.name: record_frontend_privacy_request
functions.authority: Trusted server after CAPTCHA and CSRF; database binds the actual live account session and confirmed email. Only a masked identifier suffix is accepted.

functions.name: record_frontend_privacy_intake
functions.authority: Current privacy reviewer and fresh TOTP. Manual cases begin unverified and are not linked to a customer from an unverified address.

functions.name: get_frontend_privacy_queue
functions.authority: Current privacy reviewer and fresh TOTP. Bounded numbered pages, exact counts and represented revision.

functions.name: process_frontend_privacy_request
functions.authority: Current privacy reviewer and fresh TOTP. Subject conflicts and stale revisions are denied; completion requires verified identity and deletion attestation where applicable.

functions.name: export_frontend_privacy_request
functions.authority: Current privacy reviewer with fresh TOTP; only the represented verified access request and fixed subject-scoped datasets. Oversized exports are refused in full.

functions.name: claim_frontend_privacy_notice
functions.authority: Trusted mail worker only; claims one bounded durable notice for the represented request.

functions.name: complete_frontend_privacy_notice
functions.authority: Trusted mail worker only; exact active claim token fences the receipt. A delivered deadline extension records its written notice time.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_decisions
functions.authority: Live confirmed member session, including a restricted member; limited self-only decision and appeal status. No reviewer, reporter, or staff notes.

functions.name: submit_my_frontend_appeal
functions.authority: Live confirmed member; one appeal per finalized moderation action that affects their own account, with exact pending submission retry.

functions.name: get_frontend_appeal_queue
functions.authority: Current appeal reviewer and fresh TOTP; bounded queue or represented detail, exact pending count, and conflict check without reporter identity.

functions.name: resolve_frontend_appeal
functions.authority: Current independent appeal reviewer and fresh TOTP. Represented effect version, single bound effect, exact acknowledgement and transaction-bound resolution.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_posting_allowance_v2
functions.authority: Current member only; actual slot and activation-period headroom per usable entitlement. Released activations still count toward the period limit.

functions.name: get_frontend_enforcement
functions.authority: Current restriction reviewer with fresh TOTP. Bounded active items and history, exact counts, and current reviewer conflict without reporter identity.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_restriction_status
functions.authority: Live confirmed member session, including a currently restricted member, may read only their own current account restriction type and suspension end.

functions.name: lift_frontend_account_restriction
functions.authority: Current independent account-restoration reviewer and fresh TOTP; subject, proposer, approver and reporter conflicts are denied. Represented restriction version and bounded rationale. Any separate active restriction still applies.

functions.name: release_frontend_content_hold
functions.authority: Current independent content-restoration reviewer and recent TOTP; represented hold version, subject locks, immutable cause and exact retry. Other active holds and later owner changes prevent republishing; unchanged content requires current native identity, time and funding eligibility.

functions.name: execute_frontend_report_action_v2
functions.authority: Native reviewer with fresh TOTP and current exact report lease; hides require the separate content-hide capability and represented target revision. A suspension or ban requires independent approval. An authorized emergency reviewer may contain the account for up to 72 hours pending that decision.

functions.name: get_frontend_report_review_queue
functions.authority: Current independent native queue reviewer; bounded summary and claim holder's represented target revision. A report awaiting decision contains no claim or private review body.

functions.name: list_my_frontend_notices
functions.authority: Current active self-only account and live session; closed kind projection with owner-bound warning reason and current dismissal/read state. No caller-selected owner or private staff/reporter data.

functions.name: claim_supported_notification_outbox
functions.authority: Trusted mail worker only; bounded declared supported kinds, current due leases, owner-confirmed recipient and warning reason. Old workers cannot consume new warning deliveries; completion remains fenced by the original claim token.

functions.name: execute_frontend_report_action
functions.authority: Current independent native reviewer and recent TOTP; represented report revision/lease. Native dismissal or informational warning, one exact bounded retry receipt, owner-only notice and durable delivery event. Remaining enforcement actions fail without success.

functions.name: get_frontend_area_activity
functions.authority: Current native queue reviewer; bounded program moderation/report resolution metadata and exact South African daily action counts. No report body, reviewer rationale, reporter identity, evidence key or role escalation.

functions.name: get_frontend_report_queue
functions.authority: Current native queue reviewer; independent bounded report summaries, own held review bodies/fences and private foreign lease secrets. Waiting totals include claimed work; revision and original program are derived from native report writes.

functions.name: submit_frontend_report
functions.authority: Trusted server after CAPTCHA, origin/CSRF, blocking rate limit and verified optional reporter. Represented immutable post kind and current native publication checks; complete description and selected reason retained without prefixes/truncation. No browser write authority.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_audit_page
functions.authority: Current native audit reviewer and recent TOTP; closed native event metadata and safe actor names. Bounded numbered pages, exact totals and literal filters with South African date boundaries. No caller-selected authority, proposal payload, identity number or evidence keys.

functions.name: get_frontend_governance_metrics
functions.authority: Current native governance decision reviewer and fresh TOTP; exact counts of retained native decisions, actual rejected proposals and approved overrides; no proposal payload or caller-selected actor.

functions.name: set_frontend_feature_flag
functions.authority: Current native administrator and fresh TOTP; allowlisted display keys only, represented revision, bounded modes/roles and recorded reason. One atomic audit write, exact retry acknowledgement. Security enforcement is not a toggle.

functions.name: get_frontend_feature_flags
functions.authority: Current native administrator feature capability and fresh TOTP; supported display flags with current revisions and recorded reason.

functions.name: read_frontend_feature_config
functions.authority: Trusted server-only display configuration reader. Contains no account, reason, actor or security-policy control; no browser execution.

functions.name: decide_frontend_governance
functions.authority: Current independent native governance reviewer and fresh TOTP; immutable represented proposal and case versions. Identity approval requires its own held and recently inspected evidence pair. Report approval checks expiry and conflicts, and rejection ends any associated emergency containment.

functions.name: get_frontend_governance_page
functions.authority: Current native decision reviewer and recent TOTP; bounded decision projection includes the represented report category, rationale and conflict, alongside native audit facts. No proposal payload or evidence storage keys.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_verification_queue
functions.authority: Current evidence reviewer and independent subjects; bounded waiting summaries/counts. Exact current claim tuple only for its holder; no document bytes, number or storage keys.

functions.name: get_my_frontend_identity_state
functions.authority: Current active confirmed member and live session; self-only native identity acceptance and upload/return dates independent of phone/locality completion.

functions.name: return_frontend_identity_step
functions.authority: Current independent reviewer and fresh TOTP; represented immutable artifact and exact current case/version/claim. Native return command records the reason and rejected/retake presentation without granting identity.

functions.name: approve_frontend_identity_step
functions.authority: Current independently claimed reviewer and fresh TOTP; immutable artifact/pair/version/lease and explicit match attestation. Both step approvals are required; high risk requires an independent native decision. Bounded same-lease acknowledgement replay.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_identity_context
functions.authority: Current independently claimed evidence reviewer; native case/version/lease checks and audited metadata/context reads. Private identity reference stays within the authorized review response.

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_selfie_capture
functions.authority: Current live evidence claim holder with evidence:view on an open identity case that is not their own; returns only the current submission ids and the browser-reported selfie capture method and liveness answer (review context, not proof)

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_claims
functions.authority: Current live staff; own typed post/report/evidence leases and bounded requested holder metadata. Foreign lease generations and nonces remain null; no caller-selected actor

functions.name: control_my_frontend_staff_claims
functions.authority: Current live staff bulk renew/release of its current exact native leases in one transaction; subject guards precede work rows; each underlying command and final check rederive authority

functions.name: claim_frontend_staff_items
functions.authority: Native bounded independent queue acquisition; content/report and submitted evidence candidates use their existing native claim commands and actual lease lengths

functions.name: reassign_frontend_staff_claim
functions.authority: Current staff queue reassignment capability and recent TOTP; typed independent subject, reason, current live holder and eligible independent replacement. Evidence events follow native case retention and anonymize deleted staff references

functions.name: get_frontend_staff_moderation_queue
functions.authority: Current staff queue capability and independent subjects; bounded minimal waiting summaries. Submitted bodies, private presentation and exact lease tuple are returned only after the native claim-scoped review check

functions.name: get_my_frontend_posting_allowance
functions.authority: Current live member; self-only current paid/shared/trial capacity and claim eligibility display facts. No grant, caller-selected owner, identity fingerprint, fabricated scarcity or metadata-based bypass

functions.name: execute_my_frontend_post_action

functions.name: reserve_frontend_media_upload

functions.name: complete_frontend_media_upload
functions.authority: Trusted scanner/object writer only; exact content receipt, current active owner and immutable completion metadata; repeated acknowledgement returns the same ready object

functions.name: resolve_my_frontend_media
functions.authority: Live current member resolves only its own ready media; public keys and object IDs remain independent opaque identifiers; bounded request with no caller-selected owner

functions.name: get_my_frontend_post_manager
functions.authority: Current live confirmed member; self-only actual slot usage, purchased multi-plan members, sponsorship and active paid add-on windows

functions.name: get_my_frontend_post
functions.authority: Live confirmed active member; self-only complete owner form with no caller-selected owner

functions.name: list_my_frontend_posts

functions.name: get_my_frontend_post_v2

functions.name: list_my_frontend_posts_v2

functions.name: stage_frontend_post_command

functions.name: reserve_frontend_verification_upload

functions.name: record_my_selfie_capture

functions.name: get_my_frontend_verification_uploads

functions.name: frontend_verification_upload_context

functions.name: complete_frontend_verification_upload

functions.name: get_my_dashboard
functions.authority: Current confirmed active member and live matching session; subject is auth.uid(), with no caller-selected account

functions.name: save_my_frontend_profile
functions.authority: Current confirmed active member and live matching session; revision-fenced native profile/locality commands in one transaction

functions.name: list_my_frontend_enquiries
functions.authority: Native self-only inbox with canonical owned post kind/area for accurate reply links; no caller-selected subject or base-table grants

functions.authority: Current active member and live matching session; notification ownership derived from auth.uid(), no direct table grants
